description: This file contains a comprehensive set of unit tests for the SmsManager component within an Android application. It verifies parsing, serialization, address normalization, query parameter handling, and message classification functions related to SMS/MMS messaging.

classes.name: SmsManagerTest
classes.description: A test suite class containing numerous unit tests for verifying the behavior of the SmsManager class methods.

methods.name: smsMessage
methods.description: A helper function to create instances of SmsManager.SmsMessage with specified properties for testing.

methods.name: parseParamsRejectsEmptyPayload

methods.name: parseParamsRejectsInvalidJson
methods.description: Test to verify that invalid JSON input results in an error during parameter parsing.

methods.name: parseParamsRejectsNonObjectJson
methods.description: Ensures that JSON arrays or other non-object JSON structures are rejected.

methods.name: parseParamsRejectsMissingTo
methods.description: Checks that the absence of a 'to' field results in an error.

methods.name: parseParamsRejectsMissingMessage
methods.description: Checks that missing 'message' field causes an error.

methods.name: parseParamsTrimsToField
methods.description: Verifies that the 'to' field is trimmed of whitespace during parsing.

methods.name: parseQueryParamsDefaultsWhenPayloadEmpty
methods.description: Ensures default query parameters are used when payload is null.

methods.name: parseQueryParamsRejectsInvalidJson
methods.description: Confirms invalid JSON in query parameters results in an error.

methods.name: parseQueryParamsRejectsInvertedTimeRange
methods.description: Verifies that startTime greater than endTime results in an error.

methods.name: parseQueryParamsClampsLimitAndOffset
methods.description: Checks that limit and offset are clamped within valid ranges.

methods.name: parseQueryParamsParsesAllSupportedFields

methods.name: buildQueryPayloadJsonIncludesMmsMetadataWhenProvided

methods.name: buildSendPlanFallsBackToSinglePartWhenDividerEmpty

methods.name: parseQueryParamsAcceptsEmptyPayload

methods.name: parseQueryParamsRejectsNonObjectJson
methods.description: Confirms non-object JSON in query parameters is rejected.

methods.name: parseQueryParamsParsesLimitAndOffset
methods.description: Verifies correct parsing of limit and offset.
